newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Resolute says Q1 gold output rises.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Resolute says Q1 gold output rises.

text.p: Resolute Samantha Ltd said on Tuesday total production from all mines was 74,369 ounces of gold in the three months ended September 30, 1996, compared with 50,549 ounces a year earlier.
Resolute said attributable production was 62,259 ounces in the September quarter, compared with 40,013 ounces.
It said cash cost for total output was A$369 per ounce in the September quarter, while the cost of attributable output was A$379 per ounce.
